timeline.title: Know your year-end timeline

rows.title: Corporate tax balance
rows.text: Generally due two months after year-end. Certain qualifying Canadian-controlled private corporations have three months.

rows.title: T2 filing deadline
rows.text: Your corporate return is generally due within six months of the end of your tax year.

timeline.note: Instalments, GST/HST, and payroll have separate deadlines. We confirm which apply to your business.

faq.title: Corporate tax, made understandable.
faq.text: Have a situation that doesn't fit the usual checklist? Let's talk it through.

items.question: Do I need to file if my corporation had no income?
items.answer: Generally, resident corporations must file a T2 every tax year even if inactive or no tax is payable. There are limited exceptions. We can review whether a nil or inactive return is appropriate.

items.question: How much does corporate tax filing cost?
items.answer: Your quote depends on the condition of your books, the complexity of your corporation, and the work needed. We confirm the scope and fees before starting. Bookkeeping, payroll, amendments, and CRA response work can be quoted separately.

items.question: Can I use LeadTax if I already have a bookkeeper?
items.answer: Yes. Your bookkeeper can provide year-end records for review. We'll identify any missing information or adjustments needed to prepare the corporate return.

items.question: Can I complete my corporate filing remotely?
items.answer: Yes. Start from the remote filing page or send us an enquiry. Our team will confirm the onboarding process, required authorization, and the approved method for sharing documents.

items.question: Do you help with overdue returns or CRA letters?
items.answer: We can review outstanding years and CRA correspondence, then agree on the work needed. Bring the full letter, its response deadline, and any related records to your consultation.

items.question: What about US or cross-border business activity?
items.answer: Mention any US operations, foreign ownership, or foreign income when you contact us. We can discuss the cross-border issues and confirm the services required for your situation.
